**BLUF:** No active law enforcement incidents, fires, EMS calls, or weather hazards reported in Tazewell County or immediate surrounds in the last 24 hours. Key local items include Tazewell County’s annual Fire Prevention Parade scheduled for Saturday evening and ongoing repairs at a Bluefield, VA shopping center after a vehicle crash. A Tazewell County School Board public hearing on an interim appointment is set for Monday.[[1]](https://woay.com/tazewell-county-celebrating-fire-prevention-month-with-annual-fire-prevention-parade-on-october-10/)[[2]](https://www.bdtonline.com/news/local_news/repairs-planned-to-shopping-center-wingstop-in-bluefield-va/article_72cbd2cf-8c43-4d2e-9e6c-52b2aca795cb.html)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
No active NWS alerts. No flooding, power outages, road closures, or other hazards reported.

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
Tazewell County School Board will hold a public hearing on an interim appointment to fill the Northwestern District vacancy on Monday, October 12, 2026, at 7:15 p.m. at the Tazewell County Career and Technical Center Student Center (260 Advantage Drive, Tazewell). Applicants’ names will be announced at the hearing; public comments on qualifications are invited.[[3]](https://wvlegals.com/public-notice-35612/)

Tazewell County is opposing a Verizon landline retirement plan.[[4]](https://www.newsbreak.com/main-street-dollars-395557091/4919730288249-the-fcc-has-paused-verizon-s-copper-landline-shutdown-in-nine-states)

## OTHER LOCAL
Tazewell County will celebrate Fire Prevention Month with its annual parade on Saturday, October 10, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. The route starts at Tazewell High School, proceeds along Fincastle Turnpike through Tazewell and Main Street, then Fairground Road past the fairgrounds, Riverside Drive, and ends at the VIP room after turning onto Dunford Avenue.[[1]](https://woay.com/tazewell-county-celebrating-fire-prevention-month-with-annual-fire-prevention-parade-on-october-10/)

Repairs are planned at the Ridgeview Shopping Center in Bluefield, VA, following a pickup truck crash on October 1 that damaged the former Verizon site and affected the adjoining Wingstop’s hot water system. Bluefield town officials are coordinating with Wingstop for quick fixes; the restaurant is expected to resume operations soon. The crash was attributed to driver error.[[2]](https://www.bdtonline.com/news/local_news/repairs-planned-to-shopping-center-wingstop-in-bluefield-va/article_72cbd2cf-8c43-4d2e-9e6c-52b2aca795cb.html)
